_comment: Logical name -> {folder, file (no extension)}. Code (SfxLibrary.get_stream) only ever refers to the logical name on the left. Drop a matching .wav/.ogg/.mp3 named <file>.<ext> into assets/sfx/<folder>/ -- no manifest or code edits needed. Missing files fall back to a placeholder tone automatically. file may differ from the logical name (kept as delivered, not renamed, wherever that was reasonable).

heartbeat_elevated._note: NOT USED: the heartbeat is felt in the controller, not heard.

bat_wingbeat._note: Occasional distant wing flutters (Environmental). Silent until the file is added.

river_flow_large._note: river_big.mp3 had birds in it; this is its 32 s bird-free stretch, looped seamlessly. The original is untouched.

river_flow_small._note: river_small.mp3 had birds throughout, so the cave bed and trickle use the bird-free river loop too.

reverb_bed_low._note: Low cave room tone, two of the four ambient-bed emitters. Silent until the file is added.

ambience_flavor_01._note: Occasional far-off echo (Environmental). Silent until the file is added.

ambience_flavor_02._note: Occasional far-off echo (Environmental). Silent until the file is added.

ui_success._note: Level complete in the Spatial Simon minigame.

outside_wind._note: The way-out cue (exit_wind.gd, Priority): birds outside, heard through the tunnels. Drop a real looping birdsong in as assets/sfx/events/outside_birds.(wav|ogg|mp3); the synthesized chirp plays until then. The old wind was environmental/wind_normal.

den_nest._note: PLACEHOLDER: dry nest rustle in the den (E3 reward focus target).

animal_growl._note: The stealth animal's growl: on approach, and louder when it spots the player (stealth_encounter.gd).

climb_rock_warning._note: Rock coming loose above, in the ear it will fall on (rockfall_climb.gd).

frog_croak._note: Frog discovery and pre-discovery croaking. The synthesized placeholder in animals/ is only used if this file goes missing.

bat_screech._note: The upright-bats discovery: the bat chirping recording.

ambient_pebbles._note: Short slices, quiet: distant rock settling and pebble falls (Environmental).

ambient_insect_hum._note: Faint insect hum (Environmental). Drop a distinct hum in as assets/sfx/animals/insect_hum; the swarm clip stands in until then.

notes_added._note: MISSING: the 'added to notes' sound, played whenever an observation is recorded. Drop it in as assets/sfx/ui/notes_added.(wav|ogg|mp3). Never the discovery sting.

tutorial_target._note: The tutorial's practice target, a bird. Drop a real bird chirp in as assets/sfx/events/tutorial_target.(wav|ogg|mp3); a synthesized chirp plays until then.

climb_crumble._note: A hold giving way on the final climb (grip_climb.gd).
